title: fix(encoders): fall back to cl100k_base for models unknown to tiktoken

files.patch:
@@ -97,7 +97,11 @@ def __init__(
         if name in model_configs:
             self.token_limit = model_configs[name].token_limit
         # get token encoder
-        self._token_encoder = tiktoken.encoding_for_model(name)
+        # models served through openai_base_url may not be known to tiktoken
+        try:
+            self._token_encoder = tiktoken.encoding_for_model(name)
+        except KeyError:
+            self._token_encoder = tiktoken.get_encoding("cl100k_base")

+            openai_api_key="fake_key",
+            openai_base_url="http://localhost:11434/v1",

+        assert encoder.name == "nomic-embed-text"
+        assert encoder._truncate("hello world") == "hello world"
